coverage_explanation: Exercises all four contestants, first-winner retention after release, rejection of later contestants, short-reset rearming, and rearming after a reset held longer than three seconds. Checks winner displays and serial reporting. Full coverage is not possible independently: accumulated statistics have no specified observable interface, LED behavior is unspecified, and neither confirmation-beep duration nor timestamp representation is defined. These unspecified details are not imposed on candidates.
assumptions: Uses bench-default active-LOW buttons between D2, D3, D7, D8, D9 and GND with INPUT_PULLUP.
Contestant numbers are 1, 2, 3, 4 in the stated D2, D3, D7, D8 order.
TM1637 wiring and serial baud follow the authoritative configuration.
No contestant presses overlap at the instant a round is first claimed; simultaneous-press priority is unspecified.

The reference uses a 120 ms passive-buzzer tone, a lit LED while locked, millisecond timestamps, and internal per-contestant counters. These are permitted implementation choices, not candidate acceptance requirements.
Statistics reporting, cleared-display content, LED semantics, timestamp format, and confirmation-tone frequency and duration are missing parameters.
